hair-oil.name: Hair Oil
hair-oil.short: Selected herbs and aromatic spices, slowly cooked in pure coconut oil.
description: A time-honoured hair-care ritual from Kerala.
Selected herbs and aromatic spices are slowly cooked in pure coconut oil, then filtered and bottled with care. Its natural aroma comes from the botanicals and coconut oil.

specs.method: Herbs and spices slowly cooked in pure coconut oil, then filtered and bottled with care.

ritual.title: Apply & comb
ritual.text: Take 1–2 ml in your palm. Apply gently to the scalp and hair lengths. Use your wooden comb to spread the oil evenly and remove excess.

ritual.title: Massage & relax
ritual.text: Gently massage your scalp with your fingertips for 5–6 minutes. Leave for 20–30 minutes before washing.

ritual.title: Wash
ritual.text: Wash away with your favourite shampoo and towel dry.

patch.title: Patch test first
patch.text: Check ingredients for known allergies. Apply a small drop to your inner forearm and wait 24 hours. If irritation occurs, wash off and do not use. Natural doesn’t always mean allergy-free.

faq.a: Vinaya has a natural botanical aroma of green leaves, coconut, herbs and spices. It is not designed to smell like artificial perfume.
For everyday hair care to nourish, condition and keep hair soft, smooth and healthy-looking. Suitable for all hair types.
No. 20–30 minutes is enough. Wash away the remaining oil with your favourite shampoo.

faq.q: Can I use the wooden comb every day?
faq.a: Of course. Smooth, rounded edges feel gentle on your hair and scalp while being kinder to the planet.

faq.q: How do I care for my comb?
faq.a: Wipe clean after use. If needed, rinse quickly with mild soap and water. Do not soak. Dry thoroughly before storing.

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.text: Rich in lauric acid, can penetrate the hair shaft and help reduce protein loss.

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera
ingredients.text: A familiar favourite in hair care, helps hydrate and soothe the scalp and hair.

ingredients.name: True Cinnamon Leaf
ingredients.text: While the bark is the familiar kitchen spice, its aromatic leaves are traditionally valued for their natural antimicrobial properties.

ingredients.name: Hibiscus
ingredients.text: Its leaves contain natural mucilage, giving this beloved hair-care flower its softening and conditioning character.

ingredients.name: Curry Leaves
ingredients.text: Packed with antioxidants and plant nutrients, curry leaves support nourished hair and natural shine.

ingredients.name: Holy Basil · Tulsi
ingredients.text: Known as Tulsi, a sacred and aromatic Indian plant, traditionally treasured for its cleansing and refreshing character.

ingredients.name: Bhringraj
ingredients.text: Known in India as Keshraj, or “King of Hair”. Cherished for generations in hair and scalp care.
